title: Persistent native model reuse at 91.5M parameters
hypothesis: Keeping one validated frozen base, model graph, and unchanged adapter resident across assignments will remove at least 99% of the one-shot worker's warm cache-validation and runtime-initialization time while preserving payload, numerical, privacy, and TinyStories held-out guardrails.

use_case.claim: Determine whether repeated volunteer assignments on one installation should use a bounded persistent process before investing in quantized or mapped frozen-base placement.

baseline.label: One-shot cached-base T2 worker
baseline.description: A fresh native process validates the cached 366MB base and rebuilds the FP32 model for each assignment.

primary_metric.label: Warm setup reduction ratio
primary_metric.description: Reduction in cache-validation plus runtime-initialization seconds for the reused second assignment versus the published one-shot T2 baseline.

repeated_validation_suite.label: Persistent T2 two-assignment global step
repeated_validation_suite.description: One authenticated native process completes both disjoint T2 assignments with one model build and one adapter load.

final_holdout_suite.label: Frozen T2 TinyStories validation
final_holdout_suite.description: Compare initialization and step-1 mean cross-entropy on the same four frozen validation sequences as the one-shot baseline.

guardrails.label: Canonical checkpoint parity
guardrails.description: The persistent result must remain below 1e-6 relative L2 against the centralized FP32 adapter step.

guardrails.label: Held-out loss non-regression
guardrails.description: Step-1 held-out mean loss must not exceed initialization.

guardrails.label: No warm immutable-state payload
guardrails.description: The reused second assignment must fetch zero model and adapter payload bytes.

guardrails.label: Failure-atomic adapter refresh
guardrails.description: A malformed later tensor or conversion failure must leave all in-memory adapter parameters and the old digest consistent.

independent_variables.label: Native process lifetime
independent_variables.description: Fresh one-shot process versus a bounded two-assignment persistent session.

controlled_variables.label: T2 model and adapter profile
controlled_variables.description: 91,544,064 frozen FP32 parameters and 147,456 rank-4 QKV LoRA values.

controlled_variables.label: Training and aggregation contract
controlled_variables.description: Identical data ranges, summed FP32 gradients, coordinator AdamW, clipping, dataset, and evaluation profile.

controlled_variables.label: Local host
controlled_variables.description: Both baseline and candidate are isolated native workers on the same Windows host over loopback.
